name: jev-review
description: An iterative, local-first software-quality score loop for AI coding agents, powered by Jev.

interface.longDescription: Use Jev scores as a repeated feedback loop: implement, score, diagnose weak dimensions, improve, validate, and rescore with the user's local Jev API key.
defaultPrompt: Implement this change using Jev Review as an iterative score loop: establish a baseline, diagnose weak important dimensions, improve the code, validate it, and rescore until no further justified improvement remains.
Evaluate this implementation with Jev Review, inspect the code yourself to explain weak scores, make focused improvements, and compare a follow-up evaluation against the baseline.
